This is claim-carrier precision pressure, not an architecture gap and not a ROLE_GAP. The frozen ClaimIR is not modified in this validation pass.

interpretation.main_result: All 14 relations that were not strictly preserved by G_cog are placeable in the already-frozen layered architecture without adding a system role or architecture layer.
interpretation.important_boundary: This is architecture placement, not a proof of a complete formal assertion calculus. L_claim remains a scientific assertion layer rather than a fully formalized logic.
interpretation.context_result: The system-level failures are explained by explicit separation of source/study/World context from system structure, not by promoting context nodes to C.
interpretation.claim_result: Comparison, signed association, preservation/null, implementation, manipulation-provenance, and contrastive-explanation semantics are retained at L_claim rather than collapsed into K.
interpretation.formal_result: No PVS recovery requires L_formal. One relation, PVS-CNC-02.r2, exposes claim-carrier precision pressure because a semantically required causal_position reference is present in the frozen description but absent from the frozen relation argument list.
